brief: A private on-device meeting-minutes app (iOS + Android) for a zh-TW audience. Minutes here means the record, not the duration: the mark must say 'the transcript, distilled to the key line' — calm, precise, trustworthy, the opposite of chatty AI assistants.
criteria: Success: reads at 16 px as an app icon, works in one colour, distinct from chat-bubble/waveform/brain marks, no time-clichés.

concepts.name: Key line
concepts.idea: A transcript card whose key line escapes the edge, pinned by a dot.
rationale: Reads as 'the record, distilled' in one glance
Strong at 16 px: tile + protruding line survives the app-store grid
No time-clichés, no chat bubbles, no gradient

concepts.name: Distillation
concepts.idea: Three transcript lines converge into one drop.
rationale: Drop alone can read as water — kept as a secondary accent

concepts.name: The quote
concepts.idea: An opening quotation mark: the spoken word made into the record.
rationale: Pictorial — less unique in the app grid

recommendation: Key line — adopted: strongest 16 px reading, cleanest one-colour behaviour, deployed on Android adaptive v26 and iOS 1024.
next_steps: Ship with next releases (Android 0.53.14+, iOS build 12+)
